scope: Protected private actual-input test; not a launch command or runtime receipt

source_checkpoint.revision_binding: Record exact containing SDK revision in the future run receipt; source and compiler content hashes are pinned here

telemetry_tests.scope: Exact unchanged accounting helper; getter/short-circuit mapping; source path emit order; pinned compiler disassembly setter/readback/failure branch order. Not engine execution or binary-consumption audit.

admission.ordinary_client: Existing base client; preserve any occupied owner client
admission.protection_failure_policy: Abort before input/exposure; recover only through reviewed ownership rules
admission.identity_backup_restore_bank_main_audit: Required reviewed Agent-Lab preflight and final receipts; no SDK operations added

activation.input: Real separated Fire events from actual client; actual Reload and weapon selection
activation.input_spacing: Allow each observed shot and ammo snapshot to settle before the next input; do not infer event count from key presses
forbidden: ammo reset during effect or at stop

current_source_logs.proves: Opt-in init reached; not engine-link/gameplay qualification
Confirmed handler state and captured actual getter samples for three phases; engine atomicity/notify ordering still need actual-run evidence
Idempotent stop reached; actual post-stop ammo still requires measurement
Rejected path sample/outcome; unobserved values were not read; not a successful transfer

observability.full_phase_qualification_with_current_tr: unexecuted; requires real engine run, not offline order
observability.previous_source_phase_gap: No raw fired_weapon/entry sample, reserve-written sample or clip-restored sample is emitted. A separate weapon_fired thread may run after transfer() and cannot prove its intra-handler ordering.
observability.record_format: Single semicolon-separated key=value line per transfer path after its last write; SHOT only confirmed, TRACE otherwise; unobserved is a missing value, not zero

phase_capture.status: implemented source-only in this separately pinned checkpoint; runtime unexecuted
phase_capture.scope: transfer() captures at existing observations, retains original short-circuit reads, then emits one SHOT/TRACE record after the final write of that path; failure paths stop/return without a later write
constraints: No wait/thread/notify or logging between reserve debit and clip restore
Preserve stop paths and old snapshots
This GSC delta has its own source/compiler pins and independent source review; older evidence is explicitly historical
phase_capture.claim_limit: Callback-visible getter samples after initial context guard; no timestamp of notification delivery, no global debit/notify ordering or engine compound atomicity claim
phase_capture.time_scope: trace_ms is post-write emission time, not per-phase timing

input_receipt: actual Fire/Reload/switch timestamps and event counts
minimum_evidence.sample_authority: Actual engine getters; state/log-derived values must remain separately labelled

images.content: Unmodified client weapon/ammo HUD before normal Fire
Actual Stock Option activation message and same weapon/ammo HUD during effect after at least two observed shots
Same weapon/ammo HUD after effect ended and at least two normal shots

minimum_evidence.image_binding: Native frames, actual capture times, local file hash/bytes and nearest telemetry sequence; preserve differing client/server clocks. Do not annotate synthetic counters into screenshots. Images corroborate rendering, not intra-handler ordering.
minimum_evidence.retention: Private ignored run evidence and hash-bound receipt; no binaries, screenshots, player IDs, credentials or logs committed to SDK

steps: Measure full equipped primary clip C and reserve R
Real Fire twice, separately; measure after each actual event
Perform actual retail reload and measure completed full clip before activation
cases.limits: No reload/other ammo change between normal shot samples; retail reload has its own recorded reserve debit

steps: Activate for 10 seconds on P1 with full clip C and reserve R>=2
Record ARMING time and actual state.deadline without mutating state
Real Fire at least twice before deadline, separately; record each actual weapon_fired and paired engine ammo samples
cases.failure: Pre-debit, missing/mismatched weapon or ambiguous delta must stop; never fake a debit to qualify the feature

steps: Keep reserve positive after active shots
Observe STOP expired at the 10-second boundary and cleared active owner/state
Real Fire twice after expiry, separately; measure after each actual event
cases.timing_limit: Use actual engine time/deadline and observer sampling uncertainty; claim neither exact wall-clock scheduling nor a late accepted write from screenshots

steps: Separate private case: full primary clip and independently measured reserve=2 before activation; declare any bounded harness setup
Real Fire twice before expiry
Observe reserve=0, STOP reserve_empty and cleared owner/state
Request explicit activation at reserve=0; then real Fire normally
cases.limits: Finite initial setup is not consumption evidence; no ammo reset between shots, at zero reserve or at stop

steps: Activate and confirm a real paid shot
Select another actual primary weapon; record current weapon/switching state and stop
Confirm no old-weapon refill or owner/state retention
Return to a full eligible primary and request a new activation
cases.limits: A switch input alone is not a switch event; record actual engine weapon/state

cases.status: unexecuted; cancellation may be unexercisable with full restored clip
steps: Outside effect, spend a normal round and start actual Reload
Request activation while actual isreloading is true; confirm refusal
Attempt normal Reload during effect and record actual engine behavior
cases.limits: Full restored clip can make Reload a no-op. If no actual reload state/notification occurs, record cancellation not exercised; do not lower ammo, fabricate reload_start or relabel key input as cancellation proof

cases.status: unexecuted; real P2 admission required for second-owner case
steps: P1 active: request duplicate activation and observe unchanged deadline/state
Only if a separately available real P2 exists, request P2 activation while P1 owns effect
Measure P2 normal firing and verify P1 remains sole owner
After P1 stops, permit eligible P2 activation and observe ownership transfer

expected.P2_while_P1_active: normal ammo consumption; no P2 active state

cases.limits: No fake player entity, sequential single-client claim of concurrency or automatic client clone. Without real P2, second-owner runtime qualification remains not exercised

cases.status: unexecuted; genuine death requires a separate safe harness decision
steps: Exercise an authorized actual disconnect while active; verify owner released and no orphan state
Reconnect/respawn under fresh engine protection before exposure; verify normal ammo and eligible activation
Observe actual map end cleanup only in the private candidate
Death case only with a separately approved genuine engine death in an enemy-free controlled condition and protection re-established before the next exposure
cases.limits: Maintain godmode for normal tests. Synthetic death/disconnect/faux_spawn/game_ended or scripted damage proves no engine lifecycle; if actual death is unavailable, keep that case unexercised

steps: Only if a suitable actual primary can deliver at least 65 observed single-round events within 10 seconds and reserve>=65, use real Fire with preserved privacy/protection
Observe STOP shot_budget after accepted shot 64 and normal shot 65
cases.limits: Do not extend the 10-second scenario, alter weapon fire rate, fabricate events or count key presses. If expiry wins or fewer events occur, runtime shot-budget boundary remains unexercised; source bound stays source evidence

result_contract.missing_event_or_frame: blocked or not-exercised, never inferred pass

complete_gate_requires: Actual engine Fire and callback-visible phase measurements
State exactly which cancellation/lifecycle cases were exercised; pending cases cannot inherit runtime qualification
Independent post-stop ammo and owner/state cleanup
not_implied: BO3 retail implementation or three-minute behavior
result_contract.full_plan_coverage_requires: All named cases passed with actual evidence; blocked/not-exercised cases remain outside any claimed coverage
